Is India in a G-shaped economy or a K-shaped one? How true are the FM's statements that a falling rupee has no impact on market performance? With students protesting across the world, where exactly did these governments go wrong? Is it prudent for the US to impose tariffs and increase the interest rate simultaneously? In this episode of , ThePrint Consulting Editor (Economics) Bidisha Bhattacharya answers viewers' questions, in conversation with Apoorva Mandhani.
